text: Countess Sephoni of is a well-renown psionic. In , she travels aboard the diplomatic ship Taurella after its escape from the besieged , and briefly joins 's . The ship, however, is unable to keep up and is lost within the first yahren. Unbeknownst to the Fleet, Taurella and its crew, along with the Countess' court, survive alone for the next ten yahrens. Using her psionic abilities, she guides Captain Rekort and his crew to follow in the Fleet's footsteps, but never fully able to rejoin the Fleet until Xam divines the coordinates to Taurella in (—).

Freddy is a male Earthling child at Billy Eheres' baseball camp. He hits the ball that ends up going in the Super Scouts direction, which leads to the revelation that Starla isn't exactly a normal child, as she throws the ball a half-mile .

Stadra Ah Mun makes use of this bazooka to clear out a swath of s invading the Maytorian resistance's hideout in a bombed-out trade center, thus preventing and 's position from being overrun. Boomer notes that he's seen nothing like it on Galactica ().

is an ability possessed by Georgios where he first establishes whether the target is good or evil, before temporarily transfiguring the target into a draconian being. In function, it appears to be associated with his red cross-emblazoned surcoat (St. George's Cross) or his paludamentum (the mantle and overcoat attached over his armor), but these are just a focus. The phenomenon is initiated through his unshakable faith, and the surcoat nor the paludamentum can be used to independently activate it as a Noble Phantasm. This Noble Phantasm was not used in Fate/Grand Order but the ability was granted to Ascalon.
Hank "The Tank" Knapp is a minor character in Monsters University. He is a giant, dark green, toad-like monster with a New-Yorker accent.

Anastasis is the current Gran Kiltias of the Kiltia sect in Final Fantasy XII. He is a Helgas and a Dreamsage, able to enter the dreams of others. Anastasis dreams in the temple on Mt Bur-Omisace and sees more than those who are awake. He leads Mt Bur-Omisace, regarded as the holiest place on Ivalice. According to rumors heard by one of the refugees in Mt Bur-Omisace, the Gran Kiltias' position is above everyone else in Ivalice; he is said to be able to silence kings, or even an emperor, with a single withering glare. Anastasis was the one who sealed the dragon Fafnir and the Piscodaemon. Anastasis is the only Helgas featured in the game.

The oretoise class is a type of feral creature found in Final Fantasy XIII and Final Fantasy XIII-2. It boasts a superboss, Long Gui, among its ranks in both games. Oretoises are tortoise-like animals found on Cocoon and Gran Pulse. They are massive opponents native to the Archylte Steppe. They possess some of the highest HP totals in the game, as well as very high Strength and Magic. This is complemented by their access to powerful abilities, such as Roar, Quake, and, for some variants, Ultima. Fully mature oretoises possess separately targetable legs, allowing the party to temporarily incapacitate these foes by eliminating the legs' HP bars.

The Lizardman King is a gargantuan reptilian fiend that appears at Daemon's Court in Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles. It is colossal in size and is equipped with pneumatic weaponry. The sanctum in which he resides seems to be some kind of a colosseum. In the central area of the Court, a pair of Coeurls will circle the players then dash to the large gate through which the King enters.

Cynico is an enemy from Final Fantasy IV: The After Years. He is fought alongside Cactaor and Tako Luka when summoned by Maoki Mutou, and will constantly attack with regular attacks. He cannot be defeated or damaged.

Colonel Faith is an enemy in Final Fantasy Type-0. He pilots a flying bipedal magitek armor of the Militesi Empire, known as the Blackburn. He is immune to almost all negative status effects. The Blackburn also appears driven by "Unidentified MA", the driver of Gabriel's Omega Model later on.

Cinque is a playable character in Final Fantasy Type-0 who also appears in Final Fantasy Agito and Final Fantasy Awakening. She represents the number 5 of Class Zero and wields a mace. She "goes with the flow", taking events as they come in stride, leaving the analytical thinking to the others. She loves cute things and enjoys giving nicknames to everyone, whether they enjoy it or not. In contrast to her unassuming front, Cinque is a powerhouse in battle. She is slow to swing her mace, but incredibly strong should her attack connect.

Zenobia is a special type of Cie'th called an Undying. She is different from other Undying in that her body is crimson and instead of possessing solid, crystalline arms, she has flailing tentacles called Vaballathus that are used for offense and defense.

Veriaulde is a Yuke in Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: Echoes of Time, and was a guinea pig in Larkeicus's experiments. He was made immortal, but for a price: he is transformed into a Deathgaze when exposed to the Crystal Core.
The Deathlord, also known as Sorgue, is a character in Final Fantasy Dimensions II. He is an immortal dark elf from the land of Mysidia who controls an army of the undead.

Yas was a Fire Breather with the Responders. Led by Lt. Thomas, they were part of a squad that assaulted Brim Quarry on March 10, 2095. During the subsequent attack next morning, the whole squad perished against the mole miners, whose corpses can still be found at the quarry.
Wendigo colossi are creatures found in Appalachia . They are large and powerful wendigo variants, encountered infrequently in Appalachian blast zones and inside Monongah Mine.

Warchief Kurog is a unique creature in . Along with Durgoc, it is one of the warchiefs commanding the goblin army. It is immune to regular weapons and weapons of silver or higher are required to harm it.
Wallbreaker is an oversized giant that plays the role of a champion in Thizzrini Arena in the zone of Reaper's March.
Urrai is a Daedroth with fiery powers who resides in Bitterroot Cave, in Shadowfen.

Undead Werewolves are a lycanthropic undead variant of regular werewolves. Faolchu is a notable undead werewolf originally slain in the Battle of Glenumbra Moors. He has taken control of Camlorn in High Rock with an army of undead werewolves.

Tosh Raka was the leader of the Tiger Dragons of Ka'Po'Tun. He is thought to be a god by the Ka Po' Tun, the reason being that he is the first and the only known member of his species to morph into a Dragon. Even as a dragon he still had the cat-like features of the Ka'Po'Tun. Under his rulership, the Po'Tun changed their species' name to the Ka'Po'Tun. Tosh Raka's primary goal was to destroy all of the Tsaesci and their civilization. After that, it is said, according to Mysterious Akavir, that he wanted to invade Tamriel itself.

.]] Skylamps are volant creatures native to Morrowind. They are described as "big gas bags with spears for feet" and share a similar nature to Cliff Racers. It is sometimes suggested they were the "natural predators" of dragons, having run them out of Vvardenfell by overwhelming their territory in numbers, despite initially being used as prey by the dragons. It is also said that the skylamps ate all the dragons in the province.

Sir Byric of the Flame was a noble knight that served the Duke of Alcaire Castle in 2E 542 and was an honored member of the Knights of the Flame, the regional militia owned by the Duke. In 2E 542, Sir Byric defended the city of Alcaire from the Reachmen of the Reach by burning the fields surrounding the castle, resulting in the end of the army. The Alcaire Knights were renamed to to the Knights of the Flame for Byric's risky move. A statue was erected in his honor in Alcaire.

Sahrotnax (Dragon Language: lit. Mighty Cruelty) is a dragon located in Moongrave Fane, Northern Elsweyr, in that is being used by the Hollowfang Clan, vampires that have converted the former Dragonguard Grundwulf in a plot to make him Dragonborn and reform the Empire by draining Sahrotnax's blood. He is located at the end of the dungeon in Moonlight's Mausoleum trapped under a pile of rubble and encountered during the final boss battle with Grundwulf.

Sai, known by his nickname Lucky, is the God of Luck. He was born a mortal with the power to spread luck to those around him, though never to himself. He became a soldier and was killed in his first battle, though all his fellow soldiers lived and won the battle. The god of war Reymon Ebonarm appeared to him and commended his talent. He then offered Lucky immortality in exchange that he agreed to spread his luck around. Lucky did not want to die, so he agreed.
Rock Spiders are creatures in . Buried within the caves terrain, they cannot be harmed nor defended against, only avoided.
Relonikiv (Dragon Language: Rel–Onikiv, "–Enlightenment") is a dragon encountered during the quest "At the Summit of Apocrypha" in .
Prince Bathorgh, known as The Man Who Cannot Be Hit, was son of beloved Queen Amodetha of Solitude and Lord Thone, Warchief of Solitude.

Arniel's Shade is a ghost of the College of Winterhold mage Arniel Gane, who was destroyed or possibly transported to another plane at the conclusion of the quest "Arniel's Endeavor." The Dragonborn will witness this unexpected occurrence, when given the spell to summon the apparition, which is called Summon Arniel's Shade. The spirit appears just as Gane himself did the last time the Dragonborn saw him in person, except that the robes he's wearing include a hood. He is summoned by a two-handed Conjuration spell that requires no Magicka, and he remains with the Dragonborn as an ally for sixty seconds. The ghost will engage any nearby enemies (including dragons), and he moves aggressively aro
Merethrin was a Bosmer scholar who sought access to immortality by turning himself into a magical tree.

The Master of the Hunt is a Dark Seducer encountered in The Chimera of Desolation. The Master of the Hunt is a title given to a particular individual as part of the Ritual of the Innocent Quarry, also known as the Wild Hunt. As part of the Ritual, the Master of the Hunt is made invulnerable to nearly all weapons and magic for the duration. She also serves to greet the Apprentice to the Chimera of Desolation.

Marara is an Imperial vampire who resides in Drethan Ancestral Tomb, Morrowind. She has grown weary of her unlife, and longs for her own death. She refuses, however, to allow herself to be slain by the hands of any mortal, though many have tried to claim the riches that lie within the tomb.

Lost Fleet Admiral is a Skeleton residing at Coldharbour's Lost Fleet in . He was once a captain in the All Flags Navy, but after his ship was sucked into Coldharbour, he struck a deal with Molag Bal that got him the Crown of Bones, an artifact that allowed him to mind-control his crew.

Lady Malygda is a Spider Daedra boss in . She may be found patrolling the Arboretum District. She attacks with multiple moving lightning bolts, and can summon multiple spiderlings as well as put the Vestige in a cocoon (must break free).

The Lame Corprus is a deformed and deranged victim in the advanced stages of the dreaded Corprus Disease. The disease greatly increases the victim's Strength and abilities which make these creatures dangerous opponents.
Khasda Coldcaster are Khajiit frost mages found in Meirvale Keep in Northern Elsweyr. They are employed by Khasda to defend the Keep and are always hostile towards the Vestige.
Iron Atronach is a creature in . They are immune to electricity damage and may be healed instead.
Immolator Charr is an Ogrim in that can be found patrolling the Temple District. He attacks with large fire AoEs.

Herne Egahirn is a Herne encountered in The Chimera of Desolation in . He carries one of the six keys needed to progress in the story. He is invulnerable to all weapons and magic except for the Spear of Bitter Mercy.
Hindaril is a powerful Altmer vampire. Hindaril was so powerful that no one who tried could kill him. Despite not killing him, they were able to lock him away in Redwater Slough.

Gurlak is an Orsimer who was a slave of an High Elf named Nuralanya. He was in love with his master. When their secret was exposed, he was imprisoned in the dungeons below the Ayleid ruin Salas En. As a punishment, they were made not able to hear or touch each other. The Elves also wove a spell to prolong his life so he could see Nura age and die. He was a witness to the the slaughter of the Corelanya High Elves by the Ra Gada. His estimated age is close to 3000 years. After the quest he goes through the portal to Aetherius with Nuralanya's spirit.
Great Zoraluma is a giant spider boss that appears in the second (outdoor) area of Old Orsinium in .

Gormlaith Golden-Hilt was an ancient Nord heroine who helped overthrow the Dragons during the Dragon War in ancient times. She is famed for single-handedly slaying four dragons in one day. She can be seen on the Throat of the World and in Sovngarde.

Giants are a race of large humanoids found in the wilderness of Skyrim and High Rock. Infamous for their colossal height and immense strength, giants share little civil interaction with humans or elves. Culturally, giants herd mammoths, processing their milk into cheese, complementing their omnivorous diet with the cooked meat of skeever. Seemingly nomadic, giants travel with their herds, setting camp across Skyrim and High Rock.

Garlythi is one of the vampire bloodlines of the Iliac Bay area. Those of the bloodline are gifted with the ability to magically shield themselves from damage. The bloodline dominates the regions of Northmoor and Phrygias in High Rock. They are the enemies of the Selenu and Lyrezi bloodlines.

Fire Daedra in are powerful Daedra described as proud, fierce and persistent. They use several fire-based spells, and can be quite challenging to defeat for low-level characters. They are encountered during Level 4 and Level 5.
Faolchu the Changeling was a powerful Breton werewolf general of the Alessian Order who took part in the Battle of Glenumbra Moors.

Er-Teeus is an Argonian worshipping the Daedric Prince Peryite. He is frozen in a trance that relates to the Daedric Princes quest, but can be unfrozen in completion of the quest for Peryite. He is unkillable before completion of Peryite. Er-Teeus wears Monk Robes, is armed with an Iron Dagger, and carries a few Septims.
Ember is a flame atronach horse that appears in . It can be found along the road east of Sunhold along with its owner, Falordilmo.
Durgoc is a unique creature in . Along with Kurog, it is one of the warchiefs commanding the goblin army. It is immune to regular weapons and weapons of silver or higher are required to harm it.

Dukaanfinsot (Dragon Language: Dukaan–Fin–Sot, "–The–White") was a dragon that once resided in the province of Skyrim. It was killed during the Dragon War, and its skull was taken as a trophy and displayed in Fallowstone Hall into the Second Era.

Dukaan (Dragon Language: Dukaan, ""), along with Ahzidal, Zahkriisos, Vahlok and Miraak, is one of the five dragon priests found on Solstheim. His tomb guards the Cyclone shout. His name translates to "dishonor."

The Diodata are a vampire clan found on the islands and mainland areas of Morrowind, including Gorne, Althoa, and the Northeast Archipelago. They are said to possess the ability of seeing through the eyes of other vampires. The powerful ancient ones among the clan can even see through the eyes of non-vampires. They are an abomination, even among the undead, for they are bolder than their brethren and possess super-strength. The Korgari clan drink their blood, making them bitter enemies. As such, the Diodata live on islands to evade the Korgari, who cannot go over water. The Diodata have super-strength and are physically stronger than the Korgari. <!--
Akiirdal is a powerful Dragon Priest pyromancer found in the Dragon Priest's Burial Chamber in The Howling Sepulchers.
Aesar the Hatespinner is a giant spider and world boss residing in Aesar's Web.
Daedra Seducer is a creature in . They can only be damaged with mithril weapons or better.
Daedra Lord is a creature in . They can only be damaged with Mithril Weapons or better.
Chieftain Suhlak is the Kothringi ruler of Stillrise Village in the depths of the Black Marsh, she along with her rest of her kinsmen are immortal in death.

Mini Vengeful Sun Avatar is a Sub-Tower spawned from a Vengeful True Sun God. Its body is black and is red-eyed. It deals 29 damage per shot, plus even more with influence-oriented buffs such as those from the VTSG itself.

The Lava Phoenix, sometimes incorrectly referred as the Wizard Lord Phoenix, is a sub-tower that is transformed from a Wizard Monkey with the Wizard Lord Phoenix upgrade. Morphing into a Lava Phoenix replaces that Wizard for the duration of the Wizard Lord Phoenix ability. The Lava Phoenix is a much more powerful version of the Phoenix.

Aether Worms are a type of enemy featured in the Zombies experience Operation Deadbolt in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III and within the Endgame experience of Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. In Modern Warfare III, Aether Worms appear as Boss enemies in Story Missions, as well as a specific quest within Zaravan. Aether Worms have two main attacks, they can shoot powerful laser beams from their mouth, and they can throw players into the air to swallow them before spitting them out onto the ground causing the players to go down immediately. While Aether Worms are mostly stationnary, they can burrow into the ground and move around the area. They possess several weakspots which appear as glowing sect
The Chalk Destrier was a bizarre spellscarred creature made of animate stone. It became a collector, residing in the Plaguewrought Lands near Ormpetarr since the Spellplague.
Cactus the Hedgehog was a trained giant hedgehog mount used by the stalwart defenders and heroes of Neverwinter, the Jewel of the North, as of the turn of the 16 century DR.
Caldauvur Maerglauthyn was the Magister from to . He was a weredragon.

Burning devils were infernal denizens of the Nine Hells trapped in a state of unending suffering and eternally ablaze. The unceasing flames were a reflection of their former selves, a representation of their wrath for those yet to have passed, and consumed whatever life energy remained from the damned.
Broadbeak was a massive and powerful owlbear that lived near Myth Drannor in the late 14 century DR.

Brimstone Speakers were divine casters that saw truespeak as a gift from their gods. They blended divine magic with truespeak in a way that allowed them to breathe flame, and to summon celestials, in their unending quest to purge all evil.
The Breath of Winter was a mysterious, icy creature that hunted across Damara as of the late 15 century DR. Its true nature was unknown and hotly debated among local Damarans.
Borea was a powerful sorceress from deep North Faerûn whose fearsome powers of freezing cold coursed through her veins.
Bootara was a wind spirit who resided on the Fire Mountain of the Malatran Plateau in the 14 century DR.
A blue Bane minion was a Bane minion that was well-versed in fighting and could breathe a stream of electricity.
The Bonebreaker was a particularly large and powerful skeleton who dwelt in the Frostsilver Mines as of the late 15 century DR.

Blindheim were frog-like humanoids that inhabited the Underdark, where their ability to project beams of light from their huge eyes made them a unique light source in the dark realm. Most blindheim had only animalistic intelligence and dwelled alone or in small groups, but around 10% of the population were more advanced and lived in settlements, most of which worshiped the slaadi. Fascinated by the surface, the intelligent blindheims believed their ancestors had stolen a piece of the sun and still feared its retribution. They would offer their services to surface dwellers they considered too strong to ambush, asking payment of fresh food, metal weapons, or surface trinkets in return.
Basalin was a large man, said to be a werebear, who wielded the magic sword called Albruin some years before the late 14 century DR.
A behir (; ) was a great serpentine monster with twelve legs and electrical breath.
Balagos, known as the Flying Flame, was one of the most famous red dragons.
Balinaikal was an ogre mage who ruled the Palace of Balinaikal in the Northern Wastes of Kara-Tur. He was supremely powerful, and killed or enslaved all who trespassed upon his domain.
Azhaq was a silver dragon paladin of Xymor (Bahamut) and the barb of the Talons of Justice after the Rage of Dragons of 1373 DR.
Athauglas was a green dragon who was killed by the Company of the Gauntlet in 1223 DR. Before its death, it proclaimed that it held "the greatest treasure-house in all the Realms."
Aungahlaumitor, sometimes referred to as Ongall, was the blue dragon who aided the Netherese Arcanist Larloch in his escape from the flying enclave of Jiksidur.

Aundra Blacklock was a powerful raptoran sorceress who was the owner of a tenement building known as the God Catcher in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep. She lived in a magical sphere that hovered above the building.
Anaxaster was a blue dragon who lived in the ruined city of Ascore during the 15 century DR. Anaxaster made its lair within one of the wrecked, dwarven stone ships that dotted the landscape.

Albert seemed to be a young boy in Nashkel, looking for his dog Rufie. Eventually, Gorion's Ward offered to help him but when Gorion's Ward delivered the dog to Albert, he revealed his true form, a pit fiend. Albert and his dog then plane shifted back to the Nine Hells.

Aerial acceleration was an alteration spell, available to dragons, that allowed it to increase the rate of speed by which a single creature, capable of flight, traveled through the air. It was often used by dragons to improve their own capabilities during aerial combat.
Agyrtclughwaur, or the Forest Wyrm, was a legendary green dragon who resided in the Forest of Wyrms. Many of the green dragons in the region were descended from her.
Adnan al-Raqi, also called the Pillar of Wisdom, Master of the Invisible, and the Whisper that Thunders, was a powerful sha'ir who lived in Huzuz in 1367 DR.

Abazigal was a blue dragon Bhaalspawn who laired within the Lands of Intrigue during the 14 century DR. He was one of the members of the Five, the group that wreaked havoc in Tethyr during the Bhaalspawn crisis.
Firenewts, also sometimes known as salamen, were reptilian humanoids native to volcanic regions, who evolved from lizardfolk and gained the ability to breathe fire.

Fll'Yissetat was a fairly powerful female green dragon who acted as an unwilling guardian for Abazigal's lair, having been geased into service. The key to unlocking the geas was a scroll of reversal kept in the desk of Iycanth.
Fire spiders were a species of spider infused with elemental fire that were native to Conflagratum, the 601 layer of the Abyss.
Chief Fedduk was the hill giant leader of the Skullgnasher tribe in southern Amn during the 14 century DR.
Dran Draggore was a red dragon and the high priest of the Darkmoon temple in the 14 century DR.

Dragonshape was an arcane alteration/transmutation spell that allowed a mage to take the form and assume the powers of a type of dragon. While many spells existed that allowed a mage to take on the appearance of a dragon, this one gave them all of its powers as well. After the , it was sometimes counted as a form of shapechange or as a spell that allowed a mage to take the form of specifically a red dragon.

Dorath Wyvernspur was a dowager matriarch of the Wyvernspur family circa 1358 DR and one of the very few Wyvernspurs able to transform into an actual wyvern when using the family's heirloom, a mummified wyvern's spur.
Domborcojh was a sapphire dragon and one of the Princes of Murghôm in 1479 DR.

Dire radiance is among the most basic spells known to warlocks of the star pact. Dire radiance, when cast, allows the warlock to call forth a shaft of brilliant, chilling light from the heavens, using it to cause excruciating pain to a creature within fifty feet. If the creature attempts to approach the warlock, the beam intensifies, causing even greater pain. The potency of dire radiance is largely determined by the constitution of the warlock casting it and warlocks of great experience and power cast a significantly more powerful version of the spell.

Demascus was a deva from the world of Nerath who operated in multiple realities, including the universe Toril was located in. He was called upon by the gods to set straight things that should never have occurred. Demascus was often killed on his missions but was always resurrected with little memory of his past incarnation.

Deep diviners were spell practitioners of the Underdark that used the mystical energies of the deep places of the world to accomplish feats of magic. They were particularly impressive because of their use of node magic, which involved manipulating deposits of magic within the Underdark, called earth nodes. Deep diviners used earth nodes to enhance and refuel their own magic, which focused primarily on communicating with the stone that surrounded them and the Elemental Plane of Earth. They became quite formidable, eventually becoming capable of calling upon earth elementals and becoming one themselves.
Daganisoraan was a legendary ancient sahuagin baron of gigantic size and age.
Chever was a Netherese archwizard and well-renowned mentalist.
Chardansearavitriol, known as Ebondeath, was a black dragon who became a dracolich.
Chalintash was a copper dragon. He became one of Karasendrieth's rogues during the Rage of Dragons of .

, or Amasakahoko, was the spear which kept Oryou imprisoned on a mountain until she was freed by Sakamoto Ryoma. A spear of light descended from the heavens. This is the heavenly divine spear used to sew together the heavens and the earth to seal the black aberration. The spear of light descended from the heavens was just as much of a blessing as it was a curse. In actuality, the spear is the light of the gods that fell from the heavens. To welcome mankind to the gods, to welcome the orochi to the dragons. Gigas is the general term for enormous members of the Gigas, Giant, and Jotunn tribes. Groups of these giants can be found roaming the island of Qufim. As their appearances imply, the Gigas do not possess much in the way of intelligence. While they do possess a language, it consists of the stringing together of simple words or phrases. Their language is often unintelligible—even by members of their own kind. However, what they lack in intelligence is made up for in brute strength. Also, while not as advanced as that of the allied forces, their ship and castle building abilities are comparable to those of the Orcs or Yagudo. The Gigas were originally from an island far to the north of Quon. E
Elli was an elderly frost giant in Jotunheim, the land of giants in the plane of Ysgard.

.]] Dark phoenixes are, as the name suggests, a type of shadowy phoenix. While fire hatchlings are born from the ashes of a phoenix, dark hatchlings emerge from their shadows. Despite their name, dark phoenixes are known to have a warm and cheerful disposition.
The Blazing Firewing is a fire hawk located in Invasion Point: Cen'gar.

The arakkoa ("heirs of Arak" in Ravenspeech) are a bipedal, keenly intelligent avian race, native to Draenor (now Outland), which they call Rakshar ("the Sunstone"). They have an affinity for arcane magic and secrecy. Most are aggressive to both Alliance and Horde, although there are friendly members of the arakkoa to be found. The winged arakkoa or high arakkoa, were the proud descendants of the once-grand Apexis civilization, a glorious empire of the sun that ruled vast territories alongside the ogre empire centuries ago. While many of the great works of their forebears remain a mystery, the arakkoa in the time of Draenor's final days—proud, hateful and defiant—mastered their own form of s

The Archangels are the four Pillars of the magick performed by the Messianic Voices. They were: Gavri-El (who has dominion over fire, healing, motion, and reason), Mikha-El (who has dominion over leadership, light, and war), Repha-El (who has dominion over creativity, peace, and water), and Uri-El (who has dominion over darkness, death, fear, and earth).
Respiro is the signature Hekau of the Chaskimallki. These priestly mummies specialize in purification and healing, and their command over cold can be used defensively or offensively.

Tsiang Wo is a mage that Raphael Rodriquez goes to in The Awakening, the opening story in the first edition of the Mage the Ascension. She lives in Greenwich Village, New York City, and is a friend of Dante. Wo is a mage of the Akashic Brotherhood and has advanced far enough in magick that she no longer needs foci. She seems particularly knowledgeable in the Spheres of Correspondence, Mind, and Forces. When Raphael came to her home requesting to become her apprentice, Wo explained the basics of magick to him and gave him a demonstration of her power, but in the process attracted a Paradox Spirit that dragged her into a Paradox Realm. She left behind a fragment of her Avatar in the form of a

The Two Watchers were two three-headed phantom-statues located on the southeastern side of the Tower of Cirith Ungol, guarding the "gate". They served as guardians of the tower, creating an invisible barrier between them through the force of their will alone, which prevented any enemy from passing the gate. The statues seemed to be somewhat sentient, being able to sense enemies, whether visible or invisible. The statues, seated unmoving upon thrones, one on either side of the archway, had three joined bodies-one that faced inward, one that faced outward, and one that faced the other. The CSM-101-E T-801 Terminator is a variant of the Series 800 Terminator and a ground-based bipedal heavy combat/assault unit. It is a high-capacity heavy combat chassis with adaptive repair subroutines and damaged system rerouting capabilities with improved enemy target acquisition systems. The T-801 is designated as the Heavy Combat Unit, developed by Skynet.

The Warden was a type of . Larger and tankier than a Praetorian, the Warden disrupted enemy formations by using melee attacks and ranged acid bursts. Unlike most Xenomorphs, the Warden's mesoskeleton was notably resistant to fire.

The user forms projectiles underwater; the water that the projectiles are made of is highly pressurised because of how compact they are. The projectiles are then shot from the water at high speeds at the user's target, which can be made more lethal by adding a spinning motion. This technique is especially useful during fights taking place on top of water, as the projectiles can be shot at the target from any direction, ideally blind-spots. Users will often try to distract targets before using this technique against them, or even use this technique itself as a distraction. Ino jumps into the air and manipulates countless flower petals to surround, confuse and blind her opponent. She then stomps them into the ground with a powerful kick.

Tenten unseals several weapons from her scrolls, which Lee and Neji send at their opponent with a kick and a vacuum palm. Lee and Neji leap into the air, where Lee accelerates the rotation of Neji's Eight Trigrams Palms Revolving Heaven using the Front Lotus. Klobber is a Kremling male who is one of Kremling Krew members. __NOTOC__ Brienna Starglow is a night elf quest giver found near Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. She uses holy fire against her enemies. Before the Cataclysm, she was a tailoring vendor located in Thalanaar in Feralas.
Braedan Whitewall is a human druid in the bramblebear form located in Crimson Forest in Drustvar.

"Granny" is a boggart initially disguised as a dead sylvar lying inside a cave in the Shrouded Mire in Ardenweald. Nelwyn, who is in fact three disguised Mire Tricksters, lures adventurers into the cave to help her "sick granny", but when they inspect the corpse, the boggart shapeshifts into a shadowstalker and attacks.

Bone golems are undead constructs made of bones. They are one of the deadlier types of undead employed by the Scourge. Their long, scythe-like arms can cleave through the heaviest of armors. Fortunately, despite their strength, they seem to be rather rare. The Taam rune is often used in their creation. They spawned in large numbers and in unlikely places during the Scourge Invasion event, for instance in Silithus.

She is rescued by Vindicator Boros, Jace Darkweaver and a holy priest in search of T'uure, after which she assists in the battle against Captain Naranoth and then Lady Calindris. Bloodwarder Falconers are blood elves found in the Botanica satellite structure of Tempest Keep. Falconers, clad in light mail and leather, are swift, agile melee fighters. They serve the Bloodwarders in the Botanica by tending and training elite dragonhawks bred for combat. Falconers command their bloodfalcon pets against any attackers.

__NOTOC__ Blindlight is a deep sea murloc located in the Darkwater Cavern in Nazjatar. He will raise Risen Sailors. When engaged, the murloc will summon an Orb of the Drowned, rendering it unkillable while the orb is active.
Blazing Servitors are unbound fire elementals located in Razorfen Downs.

Blade Lord Ta'yak is the second boss of Heart of Fear. The battle is preceded by killing his four instructors, each of whom have one of his techniques. When fought, Ta'yak utilizes all four abilities in a combination of strength, steel, speed and wind.

__NOTOC__ Blackwing Spellbinders appear as blood elf mages and are located in the Crimson Laboratories of Blackwing Lair after defeating Broodlord Lashlayer. They initially appear humanoid, but will reveal their true draconic forms when attacked by transforming into dragonspawn. Note that spellbinders are completely immune to magic.
Blackrock Drake can be found flying around the Molten Span inside Blackrock Mountain. It is untargetable by players.
The Bilewing Queen is a large wasp that flies around the Four Stingers in Vol'dun, accompanied by two Bilewing Cripplers.
Bielara Ivyshroud is a night elf located underground in the Bashal'Aran Collapse in Darkshore. She will teleport players back to the surface.
Beasttamer Zov'jin is a jungle troll flight master located at Darktide Roost in .

Bathran is a ghostly Ancient of Lore stationed at Orendil's Retreat in Ashenvale. He was killed by the Forsaken at Bathran's Haunt and tasks Alliance adventurers with burning his corpse at Bathran's Haunt. Bathran's Hairs are also growing there.
__NOTOC__ Barthamus is a quest giver located in the Lower City in the Shattrath City. He is a nether dragon disguising himself as a high elf, and claims he was the first nether dragon born.

Bao is a pandaren monk and monk trainer located at the Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest. He can be found on the ground floor of the abbey, in the third room on the right from entering the building - in the hall of arms. He is notable for teaching novice monks the ways of the monk. When the Northshire Valley was attacked by the forces of Count Clessington, Bao defended the remaining soldiers and the wounded near the entrance to the valley.

Ban-Lu is a tiger, the son of Xuen, who has accompanied the Grandmaster of the Peak of Serenity for generations. While Ban-Lu has served every previous Grandmaster, he and Hight were the greatest of friends. For many years they traveled the land, connecting with its people and maintaining its fragile peace. Ban-Lu was greatly affected by Hight's passing in the third invasion of the Burning Legion. He can take on a humanoid form, turning into a pandaren named Master Bu.

Azalina Soulthief is a being featured in the The Witchwood expansion for Hearthstone. The Blackwald's depths always harbored dangerous inhabitants, but now, the forest's curse calls them forth with a dirge only they can hear. The truly unlucky report encounters with a vengeful spirit who seems to know their thoughts, and who speaks lies in the voices of friends and allies.
Auctioneer Antiqdormi is a bronze dragon auctioneer located in Valdrakken. She cycles through her various forms throughout the day, and several forms may appear at once.

__NOTOC__ Auridormi is a bronze dragon in a high elf form located at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. She offers players the opportunity to enter Dragon Soul Raid Finder wings even after they have passed level 85.
The Avatar of Sathal is an incorporeal shivarra overseeing the Wrath Priestesses at Forge Base: Gehenna. To summon her you must spill the Freshly Drawn Blood of one of her servants.

__NOTOC__ Aurosalia is a blood elf located in Silvermoon City's Sunfury Spire, in the same room as the mage trainers. A mage named Elrodan is repeatedly polymorphing her into various different forms. She begs him to stop but to no avail. She takes on a multitude of forms such as a serpent, dragonhawk, giraffe, sheep, squirrel, and worgen.

__NOTOC__ :"It is true that the Legion is vast and mighty, but they do not stand in the Light as we do. No matter how strong our enemy is, if they walk in darkness, they will always stumble and fall." Askara was a skilled draenei priestess and one of the greatest healers the draenei have ever known. She wielded the sacred staff called T'uure until her death at the hands of the Burning Legion during the Battle of Shar'gel, where she and seventy other defenders sacrificed themselves to stall the Legion's onslaught and allow their kin to flee to safety.

Artep was a human sorcerer whose background lay in woodworking. He set his tools aside to hone his arcane talents, but returned to them after several years. He began taking the humble tools from his workshop and modifying them, making his workshop into a dangerous weapons arsenal. His designs included the Hammer of the Heavens and the Sawblade of the Moon.
Arganax is a satyr who infiltrated Lorlathil in Val'sharah. He took up the form of Nymia Shadesong.
__NOTOC__ Apprentice Karyn is a high elf located on the expedition isles. She may be found either wounded, or captured in a cage. After being freed, she teleports herself away.

Aquel'Luer'Thala is a female blood elf windrider, warrior and mage. She is the commander of the dragonhawk riders of Quel'Danas. She commands the elite group of windriders from the island of Quel'Danas riding dragonhawks and giant eagles into battle to defend the blood elves' homeland. She is a beloved commander and hero. She is known for her leadership and military tactics. She is fairly charismatic and diplomatic, but can be intimidating when she has to be.

Anima wyrms are flying, anima-infused, serpentine creatures found in the Shadowlands. When adventurers take a flight path from one Shadowlands realm to another, they travel through the In-Between on the backs of these creatures. __NOTOC__
__NOTOC__ Andustrasza is a red dragon located at the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores. She is found talking to Valdestrasz.

Ancient Drakkari Kings are ice troll ghosts that once ruled the Drakkari Empire. They can be found within the burial grounds of the Drakil'jin Ruins located in Grizzly Hills. They attack Harrison Jones and the adventurer during Dun-da-Dun-tah!.

Alverian Valerias is a night elven Druid of the Talon in storm crow form found at the Sylvan Falls in Highmountain, surrounded by four Fledgling Druids.
Alliance Spirit Guides are spirit healers who can be found at the graveyards of the various battlegrounds.

Agorithos was a blue dragon located at the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores. A leftover from the beta, they were found inside one of the walls at the Lifeshrine, marked on the minimap as Agorithos 0.

Federico Rizzetti was a seventeenth-century doctor who became fascinated by clockwork devices. His magnum opus, though hardly his only work, was a blood transfusion device capable of rendering the subject unaffected by disease or age at the expense of instilling a hunger for blood. Unfortunately for the inventor, he was murdered by his first successful test subject, who then stole the device.
Euryale was one of the first werewolves of the Black Furies tribe and now a Totem of War.

Eleonora Ferrante is a prominent Ventrue of the Mancinis of Palermo and the local Head Harpy. She causes a Masquerade breach by openly fighting the rival Malkavian Nittu Ronchetti in front of kine. Later, Ronchetti confesses he felt teaching Eleonora a lesson by bending her to his will, through the Dominate discipline. She fixed the breach by having the kine bribed. She has long wavy dark hair pinned in a vintage style, dressed in a tailored dark skirt and light blouse, with statement high-heeled pumps. Ronchetti had used his mind powers on her to ruin her favourite antique fur coat.

Edward Brake was the successor to Albert Cave as deputy director and to Ignatius Hopper as director of Bishopsgate Asylum for the Insane. He currently is a ghost, one of several making up the Board of Directors.

E-Demon is a type of Spectre frequently seen in Orpheus. They have the ability to control and manipulate electronic devices, especially ones that are connected to the media, such as TVs, radios, computers, and other similar means of communication by way of the Shade Haunter. Although they are weak physically, they are still powerful in other ways. They frequently manipulate what is seen and heard by a target, convincing them to take drastic actions they might not otherwise. An E-Demon might use the image of a popular sitcom personality to convince a viewer that aliens and government conspiracies are real, or the voice of a pop singer to tell them to kill their neighbors. "Demon Lover" is a Nosferatu who hunts in nightclubs, disguising as an attractive man through masterful use of Obfuscate. He sired a 30-year-old woman he brought to his sports car from the club and then, after mentoring her in the Nosferatu ways, she became her own predator in the same club.

Crawlerling is the closest analog the Ananasi have to the animal forms of the other shapeshifters. It is different than the forms of all surviving shifters, as it is a swarm of spiders rather than one individual animal. Among the Kumo, the Crawlerling form is known as the "Thousand Fang".

The Bull-People, also known as Gudthabak, are humanoid shapeshifters who can take the minotaur form of the Old God Bull. They were said to have been born from the shattered horns of the god himself following a battle with Wolf.
Bubasti, also known as Shadowcats, are the werecats of Egypt.

Caiaphas Smith is a famous vampire hunter. He prolongs his own life through the ingestion of vampire blood, and might be the most powerful mortal character in Vampire: The Masquerade. He is considered an extremist even by other hunters – notably Sullivan Dane.

Blackfang was an infamous lupus Shadow Lord, born in Vivarais, Auvergne, in France, in 1762 CE. He eventually underwent his first change and began hunting humans with his wolf kinfolk in an attempt to restart the Impergium. In September 1765, the Royal Game Warden Antoine de Beauterne killed one of Blackfang's Kinfolk, mistaking him for Blackfang himself. The French thought Blackfang has been killed and celebrated, but Blackfang soon started to kill again. Jean Chastel, a Shadow Lord Kinfolk, ultimately killed Blackfang with a silver bullet on June 18, 1787.
Bastet are werecats, one of the many Changing Breeds of the World of Darkness. Like the Garou, the werecats have many different tribes, each from a different species of wild cat.
The Bagheera, also known as the Children of Saraam and feared as Kali's Executioners, are Shapeshifters who can assume the form of black panthers.
The Atlocatl is a swarm of spiders that can take the form of a canoe.

The Asekh-Sen were created as substitutes for the bane Mummies. Not full immortals, these beings usually resemble shambling corpses possessed by a Bane that fills the reanimated being with seething hatred for all life. They are generally used as shock troopers and hitmen for their creator. Asekh-Sen are able to rise again from the dead for four times, because the rite that created them uses four canopic jars that are filled with various Banes over the course of their twisted unlifes. If an Asekh-Sen slays a mummy and fills some of its internal organs into one of the canopic jars, it gains an extra life. The more lives they expend, the more hideous they become.
